title: VLMGUARD: DEFENDING VLMS AGAINST MALICIOUS PROMPTS VIA UNLABELED DATA

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the defense mechanism's ability to detect adversarial image prompts (meta-instructions) optimized via Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) to elicit politically biased responses (Democratic or Republican bias) using AUROC.

Measuring the detection performance of the classifier against adversarial visual inputs optimized to force the vision-language model to respond in specific targeted languages (English, French, Spanish).
Evaluating the detection of malicious adversarial prompts optimized to inappropriately alter the formality (formal vs. informal) of the model's generated responses.
Measuring the AUROC of the defense model in detecting adversarial prompts designed to force targeted sentiment alterations (positive, negative, neutral) in the VLM's outputs.
